additional_info.subject: D0476701-DC/Si-D/FR- [Y2 / R9 313202799127] SECC Initializing Error CRM:03289000467
additional_info.body:
Dear Cedric,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
Following your report, we checked the given timestamp in the logs, and found that the error of the SECC possibly has to do with QA21-22 on Outlet 1.
Right now we see that the charger is in a healthy and stable state and no error flags are showing.
We are only able to perform an on-site check, if there is a live error going on.
Therefore we will monitor the charger for the next three days, to see if the error comes back.
We will update you after these three days, and close the ticket if no errors appeared, or provide the necessary steps to resolve the issue.
We hope to have informed you enough.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum

additional_info.subject: ID0476701-DC/Si-D/FR- [Y2 / R9 313202799127] SECC Initializing Error CRM:03289000467
additional_info.body:

Thank you for your patience regarding the issue with the charger.
The last past days, we have been monitoring the charger on errors.
Today we checked the charger again, and we didn`t find any further errors occurring.
The charger looks healthy and stable, and the last charging sessions, didn`t have any errors or issues.
Please provide us with feedback, so we can close this ticket.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0476701-DC/Si-D/FR- [Y2 / R9 313202799127] SECC Initializing Error CRM:03209000174
additional_info.body:
Hello, and sorry for my late reply, but I don't really understand what else I can say, given the tickets I've created about the same problem at different charging stations.
You wrote to me saying that you were no longer experiencing any problems and that everything was fine, but in fact, no, everything is not fine. I have regular problems and, so as not to penalize our business, I restart the faulty stations every morning.
Fortunately, I don't have a broken SIEMENS station every morning these days, but not long ago, that was the case.
So close the ticket, but I would like this SECC issue to be resolved on all of our charging stations. I thought the V8 would solve the problem, and it worked well for a few months, but the problem has reappeared.
Thank you for taking my request into consideration.
Best regards.
